text: I think this is probably the number one dental clinic in Chiang Mai. The dentist is highly skilled and experienced, and most of the patients are foreigners. The doctor is excellent at making dentures, speaks fluent English, and the prices are reasonable considering the doctor's skill and expertise. Other clinics have also recommended this place. I'll wait and see if there are any problems after the procedure.

restaurant_name: ทำฟัน จัดฟัน เชียงใหม่ M.Square Dental Care - Chiang Mai Dental Esthetic Center
text:
I don't usually do reviews but I saw some so-called local guide suggest that the reviews posted here are not legit and gave a 2 star review. And I noticed another person post that these are fake reviews and gave a one star. I can tell you I'm not paid to review. And as a guy from the states who's been seeing Dr. Montri for almost 20 years, this clinic and Dr. Montri are as good as the reviews suggest. I would hope that in the future, this local guide would actually make reputable reviews based on their experience-- and cast doubt and bad mouth the legitimacy of a doctor's office reviews based on conjecture because he has a hunch.

Also want to give a shout out that my wife used to be so scared of the different dentists we'd see back home, that she would get nosebleeds during some visits. Since seeing Dr Montri, she no longer gets stressed out, and has actually improved her dental health enormously in the last 20 years. She can't even remember the last time she had a cavity.  Dr. Montri and his staff always make us feel safe, and I feel like the quality of care and professionalism he provides stands up to and outshines the best available in America
